newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says armed Islamist gang members arrested.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says armed Islamist gang members arrested.

text.p: Security officials said on Wednesday they had arrested 28 members of an armed Islamist group in southeast Turkey in connection with two murders and an extortion racket.
"A blow has been struck against the Hizbullah organisation which has been trying to disturb the peace," said Salih Sarman, governor of the southeastern province of Batman.
He told a news conference the 28 had been arrested in Batman in the last month.

Hizbullah is not believed to be connected to the pro-Iranian Lebanese group of similar name. It has been accused of killing a number of Kurdish activists in recent years in a feud with the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebel group.
Sarman said Hizbullah had been forcing shopkeepers and traders in Batman to pay Islamic alms, known as "zekat". "The commercial sector in Batman can now rest easy."
He said Kalashnikov automatic weapons, pistols and bomb-making equipment had been seized.
